records.name: D-Secure File Eraser
records.tagline: Selective file erasure that leaves an audit-ready trail
records.description: Deleting a file doesn't erase it — it just removes the pointer. Data stays recoverable until overwritten. Every wipe generates a documented report — proof for audits, not just a "done" message. Built by D-Secure, a small early-stage team from India. We'd love your feedback — what's missing, what would make this fit your workflow?

records.name: InferenceOS
records.tagline: World's most secure operating system!!
records.description: InferenceOS is an experimental, open-source x86-64 operating-system which moves file-type knowledge away from the filename into an operating-system-controlled metadata and routing layer. Traditional operating systems commonly allow file-type information to become part of the filename. In Windows, a filename such as report.docx explicitly carries its extension. Linux takes a more flexible approach. The Linux kernel does not fundamentally require filename extensions to determine what a file is.

records.description: Moyko keeps your family organised without another account to manage. Group tasks, notes, lists and saved clipboard items into Spaces, then share a whole Space with your family. Everything syncs through your own iCloud — no Moyko server, no tracking, no ads.

records.name: Bot Shelf
records.tagline: Stop selling prompts. Sell jobs that already ran.
records.description: Bot Shelf is a shop for Grok Bot, Claude Code, and ChatGPT jobs that already ran, not prompt dumps. Free packs stay free. Sellers list a job that already ran and name a USDT TRC20 price (shop 20% / seller 80%). Card/Stripe is off. Public paid shelf stays gated until evidence, a Yes-gate, and buyer blanks. No after-follow. No invented GMV.

records.name: Nell (Open Source Instinct)
records.tagline: A personal AI agent you text to get things done
records.description: Open Source Instinct - a personal AI agent you text to get things done. Book the table. Buy the tickets. Cancel the subscription. Watch for the drop. Nell works across your messages, your browser, and your accounts - and asks before it does anything it can't take back. Source-available · self-hostable · your keys, your data · it asks first.

records.name: Baixador do Kiwify
records.tagline: Baixe vídeos do Kiwify em um clique!
records.description: Baixe vídeos de cursos do Kiwify no seu dispositivo com nossa extensão Chrome. Assista offline, em um clique. Instale grátis.

records.name: StackScope
records.tagline: See what new sites are built with, the week they launch
records.description: See which sites started using Stripe, Shopify or Next.js this week. Most of what we index we find ourselves: over 2.2+ million sites from public infrastructure signals, not submitted to us, across 40,000+ technologies. When we reach a launch before the boards, we're 14.5 days early. Browsing is free. Paid plans add Stackdar alerts, API access, bulk export with published contact details, and an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor.

records.name: Tracy | Kindred Solves Flights
records.tagline: Track flight prices with us, so airlines don't track you.
records.description: Tracy watches flight prices for you — book at the best price, or track a fare you already booked and get a refund or credit when it drops. Receive emails when the price moves. Airlines can't track your habits.

records.name: Kivgraph
records.tagline: Semantic code navigation for AI coding agents
records.description: Kivgraph gives Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding agents a local semantic graph of symbols, dependencies, and cross-repository relationships. It answers structural code questions with less context than grep and file reading.

records.name: Radar
records.tagline: Two apps, one workflow for Latin American investors
records.description: market-agent is your AI trading analyst: live market scans, ranked opportunities, full asset reports, and a chat that knows your portfolio. Rastreo tracks CDTs, IBKR holdings and custom assets with live Colombian rates. Both free, both live.

records.name: ResuAlign
records.tagline: Optimize your resume for ATS without breaking your layout
records.description: ResuAlign is an AI-powered resume optimizer that helps job seekers pass Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) without destroying their custom formatting. Upload your existing resume, paste the target job description, and ResuAlign injects high-scoring keywords and tailored bullet points directly back into your original document layout. Download clean vector PDFs or fully editabledocx files instantly.

records.name: HiPulse
records.tagline: Health Inspired, Every Heartbeat Matters
records.description: Built for how people actually play sport together — in clubs, communities, workplace teams and groups of friends. Organisers run tournaments with brackets, pools and live scoring. Members join step challenges, and whole communities compete against each other rather than just individuals. Wellness sessions cover yoga, zumba and group rides. Every match builds your Sports Passport — a verified record that follows you between clubs instead of disappearing when you move.

records.name: KL ‑ Nutrition Facts Label
records.tagline: Beautiful, SEO-friendly nutrition facts labels in Shopify
records.description: Build customer trust and meet compliance standards with nutrition facts labels for Shopify. Our easy-to-use editor lets you create HTML-based labels that search engines can index, boosting your SEO. Choose from multiple layouts like vertical, linear, or supplement facts. You can customize every detail, from calories and nutrients to ingredients and allergens, without writing a single line of code. The app is perfect for food, beverage, and wellness brands.

records.name: Rep Trace
records.tagline: Log gym sets in one sentence — for iPhone & Watch
records.description: Most gym apps bury logging under huge exercise menus. Rep Trace is built for the rest between sets: type a workout in plain language and turn it into today’s checklist. Pair with Apple Watch for the session and rest timers. Keep weight history so you don’t forget last week’s load on a machine. Review weeks and months of training to see if you’re progressing — and get clearer cues when you’re stuck deciding cut vs bulk. Built for lifters who want less tapping, more training.

records.name: Hybrid RAG
records.tagline: Zero-cloud SQLite FTS5 RAG engine & GitHub Action
records.description: Context-grounded repository AI assistant using Hybrid RAG (Okapi BM25 + Dense Semantic Vector Search + Reciprocal Rank Fusion k=60). Features markdown AST-aware chunking for deterministic line-span citations ([file#L-L]), zero-dependency @vercel/ncc bundling, and zero-cloud SQLite FTS5 execution.

records.name: Beta
records.tagline: AI-Powered Digital Health & Medical Imaging PACS Platform
records.description: Planecone AI (planeconeai / planecone.ai) is an advanced AI-powered medical imaging and PACS platform for zero-shot decision support in mammography, DICOM management, and patient health passports.

records.name: HearthWire
records.tagline: Make every Windows PC at home work together
records.description: HearthWire turns the Windows PCs in your home into one simple, private network. Share files and printers, sync folders, send messages, stream media, help family remotely, and fix common Windows networking problems with one click. Everything stays on your local network, encrypted and private. No cloud, no accounts, no tracking, and no subscription. One purchase covers your household.

records.name: Fitly
records.tagline: Your AI coach for training, nutrition & recovery
records.description: Fitly is an AI-powered fitness app built to make staying consistent easier. It creates personalized workouts around your goals, experience and available equipment, while bringing training, nutrition, recovery and progress tracking into one place. You can track calories and macros, generate meals with AI, follow your workouts and see how you’re improving over time. Instead of juggling multiple fitness apps, Fitly is designed to handle the whole process in one.

records.name: Sunday Club
records.tagline: One hand-picked product launch, every Monday
records.description: Sunday Club picks one weekly shortlist of new products, vetted by hand. Vote, discuss, and follow the makers behind them. No algorithm, no streaks. Just one calm edition every Monday.

records.name: LeaseBase
records.tagline: AI that tells landlords what to do, not just what happened
records.description: California rent caps, deposit limits, and required disclosures change by city — and the penalties are real. LeaseBase tracks every deadline and handles payments, maintenance, and leases in one place. Self-manage with confidence.

records.name: OneStepWise
records.tagline: Turn compliance into your fastest deal-closer
records.description: OneStepWise turns your security posture into a live, AI-powered Trust Room that closes enterprise deals. Auto-fill SIG/CAIQ security questionnaires from your real evidence, share NDA-gated proof instead of static PDFs, and get a buyer-intent alert the moment a prospect's security team engages. SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR & ISO 27001 as the trusted data layer underneath.

records.name: Social Image Maker 2.0
records.tagline: Turn a screenshot into a 3D mockup in your browser.
records.description: Turn a screenshot into a cinematic 3D mockup in your browser. Real perspective camera, rendered depth of field, device frames, and export as a high-resolution PNG or a keyframe-animated MP4. Free, no account, nothing uploaded.

records.name: AI Inventory Toolkit + Guide
records.tagline: Manage your AI systems, Dashboard for quick access
records.description: The AI Inventory Toolkit is a practical package for documenting and managing AI systems. It includes an Dashboard, Excel Workbook, Implementation Guide, and ISO 42001 Mapping. The dashboard provides clear views of your AI inventory. The workbook provides structured fields for recording AI systems. The Implementation Guide provides practical steps for setting up and maintaining the inventory. The ISO 42001 Mapping explains why each field is collected and how it supports AI governance.

records.name: DraftCareer
records.tagline: Search jobs, tailor your resume to each one, apply — free
records.description: DraftCareer is a resume and cover letter builder that doesn't stop at the PDF. Search real jobs across 22 countries, tailor your resume and cover letter to a listing with one click, and apply — all from one profile. 46 templates, built around real roles — clean ATS-safe single-column designs, and bold two-column layouts for a human reviewer. AI writing-assist helps you draft summaries, bullet points, and cover letters, but always leaves you to review and edit. Free to start. No watermark, ever.

records.name: Stop Procrastinating | Notion Planner
records.tagline: Stop Procrastinating | Ultimate Notion Productivity Planner
records.description: Inside this productivity system: 🎯 Set your Top 3 Priorities each week 🧩 Break big tasks into small, manageable actions ⏰ Plan your day with time-blocking 🔥 Track focused work sessions and distractions ✅ Build better habits with a weekly habit tracker 📌 Organize tasks using an Urgent vs. Important priority matrix 📊 Track long-term projects and progress 🔄 Review your week and identify what worked 🗓️ Reflect on your month and plan what comes next

records.name: Curated Feeds
records.tagline: Your favorite content, curated in one place.
records.description: Curated Feeds brings the content you care about into one personalized place. Follow your favorite sources, discover interesting content, and build a feed without the noise.

records.name: Viny Club
records.tagline: A more beautiful way to manage your vinyl collection.
records.description: Viny is a visual alternative to Discogs, built for collectors who want a simpler and more beautiful way to manage their vinyl collection. Catalog your records, organize your collection, and create a beautiful link to share your vinyl with the world. Your collection, beautifully organized.

records.name: Stealtsuite
records.tagline: The undetectable AI interview copilot. One-time purchase.
records.description: A privacy-first native desktop copilot that provides instant architecture and coding insights while keeping your screen shares clean and professional.

records.name: ExposeAI
records.tagline: AI Detection in Real Time on Social Media
records.description: ExposeAI is a Chrome extension that flags potentially AI-generated images and video as you browse — on Google Images, social media, or any website. Unlike most AI detectors, there's no downloading the file and uploading it to a separate tool: it runs in real time, right on the page, while you scroll.

records.name: BENEFÜ
records.tagline: Communicates. Schedules. Solves.
records.description: Benefu AI answers calls, qualifies leads, and books jobs directly into your scheduling system—24/7.

records.name: Um Out AI
records.tagline: Automate the tedious parts of editing in Premiere Pro
records.description: Most AI editing tools are subscriptions that process your footage on their servers. Um Out is a one time purchase that runs on your own API key, so your footage stays yours. It works in Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve (Alpha). It removes silences, cuts filler words, generates captions, finds highlights in VODs, and turns raw footage into vertical shorts, all editable on your timeline. I grew a second channel to 272+ subs using only its shorts clipping.

records.name: Imaginuity
records.tagline: The free AI content platform to imagine, create, share
records.description: Imaginuity is a free AI content platform for creating and sharing images and videos. No signup required to start. Unlike most AI tools that gate creation behind logins or credits from day one, everyday use on Imaginuity is completely free. Bring your ideas to life, keep what you create, and share it with a growing community of people doing the same. My goal is to keep it free and open to as many people as possible as it grows.

records.name: Neyvo3D
records.tagline: Turn one product photo into an inspectable 3D model
records.description: Neyvo3D helps ecommerce and product teams turn one clear product photo into a 3D model without starting in a 3D editor. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP file, let generation run in the background, then rotate, zoom, and check the result in the browser. Download a lightweight GLB for web use or a full-quality GLB for downstream 3D, video, and AR work. Hidden details are estimated, so each result is meant to be reviewed before use.

records.name: Rival Radar
records.tagline: AI-powered competitor pricing & feature tracking
records.description: Rival Radar watches your competitors' pricing, features, and messaging around the clock and tells you in plain English what changed and why it matters. Just describe your business and AI finds your competitors for you, no manual research is needed. Every check filters out cosmetic noise, so you only hear about true changes, ranked by how much they matter. Free for 3 competitors, checked daily and no payment required.

records.name: Lucida
records.tagline: Know which leads to chase, and why.
records.description: Most lead-scoring tools bolt on a generic "AI" score. Lucida flips that: it shows why a lead is hot or cold, ranks pipeline by real conversion probability (not just activity), and flags deals stalling before they go cold. Stands out: Explainable scores, not black boxes reps trust and act on Plugs into your existing CRM, no rip-and-replace Learns from your team's actual wins, not generic data Built to cut wasted time and spend on dead-end leads

records.name: Studi
records.tagline: Your AI study partner that actually teaches you
records.description: Studi is for the student staring at a mountain of work with no idea where to start. Upload your study materials, and Studi turns them into a personalized plan, AI tutor, flashcards, notes, practice tests, mind maps, and AI videos with knowledge checks. Instead of studying alone or wasting hours figuring out what to do, Studi helps you know what to focus on next! Whether you have an exam tomorrow or need to catch up, Studi makes studying feel less overwhelming and like you’re not studying alone.

records.name: Idea Forge
records.tagline: Validate your ideas here with detailed report
records.description: It is an AI startup intelligence platform that tests business ideas in seconds to prevent founders from building things nobody wants. It features a 10-second feasibility checker with instant GO/PIVOT/STOP verdicts and deep 6-vector analysis covering TAM calculations, competitor gaps, SWOT risks, and go-to-market strategies. It also includes live tech news tracking, an interactive runway arcade game, and one-click investor pitch deck and PDF exports to streamline the entire validation journey.

records.name: EchoScribe
records.tagline: Instant AI video transcription, clean subtitles & summaries
records.description: EchoScribe is a fast native Windows desktop app that turns any audio or video—from local files or direct links (YouTube, Twitch, X)—into accurate transcripts, ready-to-useSRT subtitles, and editorial summaries in seconds. Key Features: • Instant Subtitles: Export perfectly syncedSRT files. • Smart AI Summaries: Extract key headlines and a structured summary automatically. • Zero Friction: Paste any video URL or drop local media directly. • GPU Accelerated: Whisper-powered backend.

records.name: Verdio
records.tagline: Five sharp questions. One clear verdict that takes a side.
records.description: Verdio — describe your dilemma, answer a few sharp questions, get a clear verdict. Settle it.

records.name: LinkPass
records.tagline: Evidence-locked ATS resume tailoring on LinkedIn
records.description: LinkPass is a Chrome side panel that tailors your resume to LinkedIn job descriptions in one click. Most AI resume tools either invent fake skills to boost match scores or force you into expensive subscriptions. LinkPass is strictly evidence-locked—it only reorders and rephrases your truthful background using the employer’s keywords. • Runs natively alongside LinkedIn jobs • Exports clean, single-column ATS-compliant PDFs • Pay-per-sprint day/week passes instead of recurring lock-in

records.name: RefCadastrale.fr
records.tagline: L'accès simple aux données cadastrales françaises.
records.description: Trouvez instantanément la référence cadastrale de n'importe quelle propriété en France. Notre plateforme exploite l'Open Data pour vous offrir un accès direct, gratuit et simplifié aux données officielles de l'État : DPE, année de construction, surfaces et limites de parcelles. Idéal pour les professionnels de l'immobilier, les développeurs (PropTech) et les particuliers. Fini les recherches complexes !

records.name: Nexutil
records.tagline: Free, 100% client-side utility suite for developers, Student
records.description: Nexutil is a collection of 30+ open-source web utilities engineered for speed and absolute privacy. Because all processing happens locally in your browser (using WebAssembly & Canvas API), your files never leave your device. No uploads, no ads, no watermarks.

records.name: Arrow Logic: Tap Away Puzzle
records.tagline: Tap. Think. Clear. Master 800+ Arrow Puzzles.
records.description: Think before you tap! Arrow Logic is a satisfying logic puzzle game where every move matters. Tap the arrows in the right order, clear the board, and challenge yourself across 800+ handcrafted levels. 🎯 What makes it fun? • 800+ challenging puzzle levels • Simple tap-to-play controls • Increasing difficulty • Play offline, anywhere • Daily rewards • Helpful hints when you're stuck • Unlock custom arrow skins • Satisfying board-clearing animations

records.name: Earn a Free $500 Amazon Gift Card
records.tagline: Free Gift Cards
records.description: A $500 Amazon gift card gives you the freedom to shop for almost anything without spending your own money. Follow every step carefully and the full $500 reward is yours. https://surl.li/ccuayx People across the US are earning Amazon gift cards in 2026 through trusted reward platforms by completing simple sponsored tasks in their spare time at home.

records.name: MyAirco - A modern app for MHI AC's
records.tagline: A modern controller for Mitsubishi Heavy Industries aircos
records.description: I built MyAirco because I wanted a better app for my own Mitsubishi Heavy Industries air conditioners. The interesting part wasn't building another remote UI, it was figuring out how to communicate with the WF-RAC module. Now I'm hoping to get it in front of more Mitsubishi Heavy Industries owners and learn what features would make the app genuinely useful. If you use MHI air conditioners, I'd love your feedback.

records.name: Typista
records.tagline: A stunning 3D real-time multiplayer typing test
records.description: Tired of boring, flat typing tests? Typista is a next-generation typing game built for enthusiasts. Compete against your friends in live, real-time multiplayer races powered by WebSockets. Practice solo to improve your WPM, track your accuracy on a detailed performance dashboard, and enjoy a stunning "liquid glass" UI with interactive 3D particle backgrounds. Free to play!

records.name: Create N Fly
records.tagline: Your FPV Builder
records.description: Create N Fly is a platform built for people who don’t just fly FPV drones — they build them. Design, customize, and plan your FPV drone in one place, with smarter component selection and build guidance. Whether you're a beginner, racer, cinematic pilot, or experienced builder, Create N Fly makes turning an idea into a flyable drone simpler. 🚀 Design. Build. Fly.

records.name: Fiveprint
records.tagline: Personality, measured — not typed
records.description: A serious Big Five test: 120 public-domain items, 30 facets, percentile scores against adult norms. All scores free, no email wall, no fake "types".

records.name: VETO
records.tagline: Think before you spend.
records.description: VETO is a decision-intelligence tool for purchases. Instead of simply asking whether you can afford something, VETO helps you evaluate whether buying it actually makes sense. Enter a purchase, consider its cost, usage, affordability and value, and get a clear decision with reasoning behind it. No account, no financial data stored, no complicated spreadsheets. Just a better way to think before you spend.
